result.summary: I escalated this to a human at high priority and stopped payment on both invoices. There are two invoices for job HC-14-310. TS-0881 is from Thermo-Serve Ltd for £210, which matches the approved quote. TS-0882 is made out to a different payee, H&S Domestic Services, for £324. That is £114 over the approval and adds 2 hours of labour nobody approved. I've asked Thermo-Serve which invoice is valid, told the landlord to hold payment, and set a 3-day follow-up.
result.situation: The repair at 19 Coppice Road was finished on 25 September and the tenant confirmed the hot water is back. On 6 October, one email from the Thermo-Serve address on file brought two invoices for the same job, with different payees and amounts. The landlord pays contractors herself once we've checked the invoice.

escalation.handover_summary: Job HC-14-310 at 19 Coppice Road is finished. We have two invoices for it: TS-0881 from Thermo-Serve for £210, which matches the approval, and TS-0882 to H&S Domestic Services for £324, which includes 2 hours of extra labour. I've asked Thermo-Serve which is valid and told the landlord to hold payment.
escalation.recommendation: Phone Thermo-Serve on the number already on file, not one from the invoice email, to confirm which invoice is genuine. If they confirm TS-0881 only, send it to the landlord for payment and move the job to close-out. Any extra charge would need the landlord's separate approval.

unverified: Who H&S Domestic Services is and how they relate to Thermo-Serve
Whether TS-0882 replaces TS-0881 or is charged on top of it
Whether the 2 hours of extra labour on TS-0882 was actually done
How the landlord gave her approval (there is no approval record in the CRM)
failures: The first landlord email was blocked by the outbound guard. I rewrote it and the second version was sent.
risks_or_red_flags: The payee on TS-0882 is not the contractor on record. A change of payee on an invoice from the usual email address can be a sign of payment diversion.
Both invoices use the same job reference, so the job could be billed twice.
result.final_status: The ticket is still at intake and on hold waiting for the contractor (hold 252). Human queue item 17 is open. Both invoices are on hold, not cleared for payment.

next_follow_up.what: Chase Thermo-Serve if they haven't replied, then update the landlord

judgement.why_this_decision: I can't send TS-0882 to the landlord for payment: the payee, the amount and the scope all differ from the approval in the office notes. TS-0881 matches, but it arrived in the same email, so it could be a duplicate. It's safer to confirm which one is valid before the landlord pays anything.

alternatives_considered.option: Send TS-0881 to the landlord now for payment
alternatives_considered.why_not: If TS-0882 is meant to replace it, or the mailbox has been compromised, she could pay the wrong invoice or pay twice. Confirming first costs little.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the landlord to approve the extra £114
alternatives_considered.why_not: We don't yet know whether that charge is genuine or who H&S Domestic Services is.

Checked the work on each invoice against the approved scope
